_readme: Orion Drift master server directory. Commit this file to a PUBLIC GitHub repo and point OrionProductionBrowser > Registry Url at its raw link:
Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) are ignored by the client, so they are safe inline documentation. Strict JSON: no comments, no trailing commas.
Clients re-fetch every ~3 minutes and cache the last good copy, so edits go live without a client update.
Every entry is untrusted input on the client: invalid entries are skipped, rich-text tags are stripped, and hosts resolving to loopback/private/LAN/CGNAT/multicast addresses are blocked.
Use PUBLIC hostnames or public IPv4 addresses only. Hosts shown below are placeholders.
